rules: gap day: |first M1 open - previous real day close| >= 0.25 x ADR(20)
target = open - sign(gap) x ADR (a full ADR move from the open, against the gap)
observed: reached within the trading day, after the first M1 bar
null: same absolute distance and direction from the open of random non-gap days within +/-30d
claim -: the gap spends the budget, so gap days reach the ADR target less often

params.adr_stat: mean H-L of completed real days
params.target_distance: 1.0 x ADR from the day open, against the gap
params.null: random non-gap real day within +/-30 calendar days, same absolute distance, same direction, its own full day
params.horizon: rest of the trading day after the first M1 bar (horizon_bars)

params_source.adr_lookback_days: corpus: X4XSsv5CNqg (average-daily-range) 'a daily chart with at least the current month visible' -> ~20 trading days (declared-before-run, as in risk_own_01b)
params_source.adr_stat: corpus: NESSCPMzWR0 'maybe an 80-point range, let's just give that for the average daily range'
params_source.gap_cut_adr: declared-before-run: corpus gives no gap size ('large enough to be obvious'); 0.25 ADR
params_source.gap_ref: declared-before-run: gap = open vs previous close (the corpus measures the budget from the open)
params_source.target_distance: corpus: NESSCPMzWR0 'If we open right here, we could see 80 points ... with a gap up ... our 80 points become a lot harder to reach'
params_source.null: declared-before-run: measurable 'hit rate of the far target on gap-open days vs non-gap days'
params_source.stub_day_min_n_m1: declared-before-run: skip data-hole stub days (README trap 6)
params_source.horizon: corpus: NESSCPMzWR0 'are we still looking for this low in one day? No'

verdict_detail: CI contains 0; MDE 0.1369 vs threshold 0.0386, effective n 70 (power floor n=882, have 70)

lookahead.no_detector_declaration: pure level rule: daily open, previous close and ADR from completed days (build_bars 1D), outcome via touch

notes: The rule's substitution step (pull the target to the previous day's low) is a target choice, not a claim; the testable content is that a full-ADR move from a gapped open is harder than from an ordinary open.
